memberdef.name: runChunks

briefdescription.para: Searches a large byte range in parallel chunks, with one output document for each chunk.

detaileddescription.para: The chunks are cut at a newline, so each line is in one chunk. The chunks are counted for their newlines and their NUL bytes first, so that each chunk knows its first line number. Then the chunks are searched in parallel. A NUL byte in any chunk makes an explicit input or a counted input binary, and that is reported at once. Otherwise a failure is returned before any output, and a binary status is returned when the input is not explicit and the search failed or found a match. The documents are returned in chunk order, and empty chunks give no document.

parameterdescription.para: The bytes to search.
The path shown in the output.
The compiled pattern.
True when the input was named as a file on the command line.
True to prefix the output lines with the display path.

simplesect.para: Status result, the number of matching lines, and the output documents, one for each chunk.
